Definition: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
BiblicalUsage: 1) brother; 1a) brother of same parents; 1b) half-brother (same father); 1c) relative, kinship, same tribe; 1d) each to the other (reciprocal relationship); 1e) (fig.) of resemblance
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
